title.narrative: Support of the Southern Africa Trust Programme

description.narrative: This activity Support of the Southern Africa Trust Programme is a component of Africa Regional Programme for Improved Empowerment and Accountability in Africa reported by FCDO with a funding type of 111 - Not for profit organisation and a budget of £6,999,998. This project benefits Africa, regional. It works in the following sector(s): Democratic participation and civil society, Research/scientific institutions, Human rights.
